Every child with K<8 is SAT despite parent UNSAT
Same n,K,bit length for matched SAT and UNSAT children when K>=8
Combinatorial rank/unrank exact for every enumerated selector

Independent brute force model counts for every M=10 selector at K=7 and K=8

duplication_audit: The entropy lower bound and index-array upper bound were already in MAIN_SELECTOR_VIRTUAL_CHILD62. New here is a concrete common-parent both-label family, exact counts, independent child-bit reproducibility, and label-only vs full-service separation.
first_open_arrow: Uniform all-input semantically correct charged SAT contraction into FLMV forbidden simultaneous time-space region.
limitations: Log(binomial(M,K)) lower bound only when a fixed decoder must encode all K-subsets of one fixed parent without external selector advice.
No theorem forces an ARC contractor to select from the entire K-subset universe.
One-bit SAT decision need not produce a full child, selector, witness or proof.
Finite tests do not establish universal asymptotic SAT hardness.
Remote GitHub mini-audit is smaller than the full locally executed auditor.
